description: The SDM Funnel turns a sequence of funnel steps into a diagnostic conversion chart. Beyond drawing the funnel, it computes the leakage between consecutive steps and tests whether each drop is statistically significant against a comparison group. Key features: Leakage pills: the drop between two consecutive steps, colour-coded above / below / neutral versus the comparison Significance testing: two-proportion z-test on scores and on conditional leakage rates, with a configurable significance level Up to three partitions: a main series plus two comparison series, each with its own name and base64 logo Competition leakage arrow: three shapes (Curved, Asymmetric Curved, Ribbon) with adjustable colour, transparency and label Up to eight extra columns: continuous or discrete scores, precision control, and six display modes (Value, Gap, Value & Gap and their comparison variants) Bars: vertical gradient with independent top and bottom colour and opacity, constant-size taper or straight rectangle bars, adjustable gap Grouping: repeat the whole funnel by a Group By field such as country or brand, with logo and text headers Funnel frame: border, corner radius, background, shadow and halo Typography: full font control for values and step labels, with optional text halo for readability Flexible ordering: keep the order from the data instead of sorting by score, for funnels where a later…
